journey.completion_evidence: product-motion.gif is local and playable, contains 67 recorded frames over 14.150 seconds, and is tied to three retained key states matched into it at 0.5s, 6.5s and 9.0s (mean abs diff 0.0391, 0.043 and 0.0078/255).

observations: Every region carries its name as text in the border - 'Status', 'Files - Worktrees - Submodules', 'Local branches - Remotes - Tags', 'Commits - Reflog', 'Stash', 'Unstaged changes'/'Staged changes', 'Command log' - so a region is identifiable without colour.

The footer line names the action of the focused context in words and echoes the key that was pressed: 'Stage a file' at 0.5s, 'Commit our changes  Pressing <tab>' at 4s, 'Push to the remote  Pressing P' at 9s.

File state is a letter code beside the filename ('A' for added, '??' for untracked) and list position is printed as text in the panel border ('1 of 2', '1 of 30', '1 of 31'), so neither depends on colour alone.

Measured on state-1.png: the selected row's text rgb(255,153,153) on its blue selection bar rgb(0,51,153) is 5.3:1 and the footer's white rgb(255,255,255) on black is 21:1; the diff pane's cyan rgb(153,255,255) on black is 18.1:1.

Long-running work is reported as text plus a spinning character in a bordered panel ('Pushing... -', 'Pushing... /'), and the Command log keeps the git command that produced each change ('git add -- my-file.txt', 'create mode 100644 my-file.txt', 'bed3ebc..0853c88  feature/demo -> feature/demo').
unknowns: Screen-reader behavior was not exposed by the upstream recording.
The colours measured above are those of the upstream recording's terminal theme, not of an arbitrary user terminal.
No product-level reduced-motion setting appears anywhere in the recording.
Mouse parity, switch-control mappings, and nonvisual ordering are not visible in the GIF.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product

motion_analysis.trigger: A keyboard sequence over the running lazygit surface, readable from the footer's key echo: space to stage the selected file, 'c' to open the commit editor, <tab> to move from summary to description, Enter to commit, then 'P' to push.
motion_analysis.start_state: At 0.5s the Files panel is focused with '?? my-file.txt' selected and its diff shown in the 'Unstaged changes' pane; Commits reads '1 of 30' and Status has no ahead marker.
motion_analysis.end_state: At 11s the file is committed and pushed: Commits reads '1 of 31' with '0853c88f my commit summary' on top, Status shows the clean check mark again, the Command log's last line is 'bed3ebc..0853c88  feature/demo -> feature/demo', and by 12s the surface has been quit and the terminal is empty.
motion_analysis.continuity: Panels never move or resize; each step repaints in place. Staging flips the file's marker from '??' to 'A' and retitles the right pane 'Unstaged changes' -> 'Staged changes' while its diff text stays identical, and the commit editor opens as two bordered boxes over the middle of the layout without disturbing the panels around it.
motion_analysis.feedback: Blue selection bar, yellow-green active border on the focused panel and on the commit editor, the footer's action name plus echoed key, the '↑1' ahead marker in Status and beside the branch, the 'Pushing... -' / 'Pushing... /' spinner panel, and the Command log line appended per git command.
motion_analysis.reduced_motion_equivalent: The only animation in the recording is the one-character push spinner; every other change is an instant text repaint that persists, and the push is also reported non-animatedly by the '↑1' marker and the Command log line. No reduced-motion preference is shown in the product.
